regions.summary: Deyang's northwest: Mianzhu (42%) and Shifang (39%), foothills of the Longmen range, with a sliver of Guanghan and Jingyang.

candidates.name: Mianzhu
candidates.meaning: "Bamboo along the Mian": named for the bamboo on the banks of the Mian water (now Mianyuan River).
candidates.fit: Holds 94% of Mianzhu's people and is 42% of the region; the Han county seated at today's Mianzhu or just north of Deyang.
candidates.recognisability: Current county-level city; known for Jiannanchun liquor and Mianzhu New Year prints.
candidates.source_note: 西汉初置绵竹县，因境内绵水（今称绵远河）之滨多竹而得名

candidates.name: Shifang
candidates.meaning: Han county Shifang (written 汁方 at first); the lead says Li Bing worked and died here and the town is also called Yongcheng after the general Yong Chi.
candidates.fit: Holds 99.6% of Shifang's people and is 39% of the region; nearly as large a share as Mianzhu.
candidates.recognisability: Current county-level city; known for cigars and mineral water, and as the 2012 protest site.
candidates.source_note: 汉代名将雍齿的受封之地，故什邡城又名雍城

regions.notes: Two near-equal units. I put Mianzhu first because its county is older and the Mian River basin is the region's spine; Shifang is equally defensible.

regions.summary: Deyang city: Jingyang district (93%) and a little of Guanghan, on the Mianyuan River.

candidates.name: Deyang
candidates.meaning: Tang county Deyang, split from Luo county in 620; the prefecture's name today.
candidates.fit: Seat of the prefecture-level city; Jingyang district is the whole built-up city. Urban population is about 0.9M, so the over-1M rule does not force it, but nothing fits better.
candidates.recognisability: Prefecture of 3.5M; heavy machinery centre.
candidates.source_note: 唐武德三年（620年）析雒县置德阳县（治今旌阳区）

candidates.name: Jingyang
candidates.meaning: District name chosen in 1996, from the Qing-era Jingyang post station in Deyang county; 旌 is a banner or flag.
candidates.fit: Holds 87% of Jingyang district and is 93% of the region.
candidates.recognisability: Current district name, little known outside Sichuan.
candidates.source_note: 清代德阳县亦曾有旌阳驿。1996年8月3日，撤销市中区，设立旌阳区

regions.summary: Dujiangyan (67%) at the Min River's mouth onto the plain, with Longmen mountain parts of Chongzhou and Pengzhou.

candidates.name: Dujiangyan
candidates.meaning: "Capital river weir": Li Bing's irrigation works of the Warring States, which gave the city its name in 1988; before that the county was Guanxian.
candidates.fit: Holds 99.7% of the city's people and is 67% of the region; the weir sits at the region's heart.
candidates.recognisability: UNESCO World Heritage site, very well known.
candidates.source_note: 1988年5月，经中国国务院批准撤销灌县设立都江堰市，以李冰父子建造的都江堰而得名

candidates.name: Qingcheng
candidates.meaning: "Green city" mountain, an old name Zhangren Shan; one of the birthplaces of Daoism.
candidates.fit: Lies within Dujiangyan, south-west of the weir; a landscape name for the western mountain half of the region.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 1031 hits with 四川, top ones about this place; World Heritage with the weir.
candidates.source_note: 位于四川省成都市都江堰市西南，古称「丈人山」

regions.notes: Dujiangyan is the obvious pick; Qingcheng is only worth it if Anita wants the weir name kept elsewhere.

regions.summary: North of Chengdu plain: Pengzhou (62%) and the Xinfan part of Xindu (26%).

candidates.name: Pengzhou
candidates.meaning: Tang prefecture of 686, named for the Tianpeng gate (天彭阙); one view says it was the old state of Peng.
candidates.fit: Holds 71% of Pengzhou's people and is 62% of the region; also the prefecture seat (Pengzhou) covered Jiulong, Daoyang, Tangchang and Mengyang counties.
candidates.recognisability: Current county-level city, own zh-wiki article.
candidates.source_note: 垂拱二年（686年）分益州九陇、导江、唐昌、濛阳四县置彭州，因天彭阙为名

regions.notes: Sanxingdui museum (Nanxing town, Guanghan) falls inside this region by the town data (Nanxing 91% here), not in region 5, even though Guanghan's centre is in 5. Xinfan (new Fan county, 1350 yrs, 201 hits with 四川, no own article) was left out as too obscure.

regions.summary: Guanghan (52%) and Qingbaijiang (36%) on the plain east of Deyang, with a bit of Jintang.

candidates.name: Guanghan
candidates.meaning: Han commandery, said to be named for reaching the Han river ("广至汉水"); the town was earlier Luo county and Hanzhou.
candidates.fit: Holds 71% of Guanghan's people and is 52% of the region; Luo county was the seat of Guanghan commandery and Yizhou province for centuries.
candidates.recognisability: Current county-level city.
candidates.source_note: 汉朝为广汉郡，因“广至汉水”而得名；古称雒城、雒县、汉州

candidates.name: Sanxingdui
candidates.meaning: "Three star mounds": the Bronze Age Shu site on the Duck River at Guanghan, 3700 years old.
candidates.fit: Site is in Guanghan on the boundary between this region and region 4; by town data Nanxing town sits in region 4, so only partly fits.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 810 hits with 四川, top ones about this place; very well known.
candidates.source_note: 三星堆文化的出现标志着四川盆地进入青铜时代，距今约3700年

candidates.name: Qingbaijiang
candidates.meaning: "Blue-white river", the river the district is named for; the district was founded in 1960 for a fertiliser plant and is now a rail freight hub.
candidates.fit: Holds 75% of the district and is 36% of the region.
candidates.recognisability: Current district; 1960 industrial creation, little history.
candidates.source_note: 青白江区因境内的青白江而得名，并因工业建设的需要在1960年设立

regions.notes: Sanxingdui fits better on the map for region 4 or for neither; check the pin before using it here.

regions.summary: Zhongjiang county (87%), a large hilly county east of Deyang, with a little of Lezhi.

candidates.name: Zhongjiang
candidates.meaning: Renamed in 1012 from Xuanwu county, which was Wucheng county under Shu Han.
candidates.fit: Holds 98% of the county and is 87% of the region; the Wucheng/Xuanwu seat sat 2 li east of today's seat.
candidates.recognisability: Current county; known for dried noodles, a million-people county.
candidates.source_note: 三国蜀汉时置五城县，隋改玄武县，宋真宗大中祥符五年（1012年）改为中江县

regions.notes: No better alternative; Wucheng (五城) and Xuanwu (玄武) are too obscure.

regions.summary: Pixian: the county west of Chengdu, now Pidu district (99%).

candidates.name: Pixian
candidates.meaning: County name Pi (郫) used from 314 BC until 2016; Pidu is its district name now, after the old Shu capital Pi.
candidates.fit: Holds 64% of the old county and is 99% of the region; the seat is in the region.
candidates.recognisability: Known for Pixian doubanjiang chili bean paste.
candidates.source_note: 郫（pí）都区，原为郫县，别称鹃城

candidates.name: Pidu
candidates.meaning: "Capital of Pi": the present district name since 2016.
candidates.fit: Same place as Pixian.
candidates.recognisability: Current admin name, less known than Pixian.
candidates.source_note: 郫都区，原为郫县

regions.notes: Pixian and Pidu are one place; pick one.

regions.summary: Xindu district, Chengdu's northern suburb (94%).

candidates.name: Xindu
candidates.meaning: "New capital": built by the Kaiming kings of Shu to tell it apart from the old Shu capital at Pi.
candidates.fit: Holds 58% of the district and is 94% of the region; seat in the region.
candidates.recognisability: Current district, Han county for 2090 yrs.
candidates.source_note: 新都为古蜀国都邑……为有别于杜宇氏的旧都郫邑，得名“新都”

regions.notes: Xindu is also the name of Xindu commandery at Guanghan (266-284), 80 km away; not an issue unless a neighbour uses it.

regions.summary: Suburban sliver between Pixian, Xindu and Jinniu: Xipu, Anjing, Tianhui.

candidates.name: Xipu
candidates.meaning: "Rhinoceros shore": said to come from Li Bing sinking stone rhinoceroses in the water to subdue floods; Xipu county 686-1071.
candidates.fit: Xipu town is 19% of the region; Pi county is 63% of it; the Tang county seat lay at Xipu.
candidates.recognisability: Own article for the sub-district, 118 hits with 四川; known for the Southwest Jiaotong University campus and metro terminus.
candidates.source_note: 相传犀浦得名于李冰治水时“石犀沉之于水以压怪”。唐垂拱二年（686年）设犀浦县

regions.notes: A split fringe region with no historic unit of its own. Tianhui (天回镇) was checked: 58 hits, stub article, dropped.

regions.summary: Wenjiang district (96%), the western suburb on the Jinma and Jiangan canals.

candidates.name: Wenjiang
candidates.meaning: "Warm river": county name since 553; the lead calls it "gold Wenjiang" for its fertile land.
candidates.fit: Holds 95% of the district and is 96% of the region.
candidates.recognisability: Current district, 1313 yrs as a county.
candidates.source_note: 温江县（县, 553-1911）CHGIS; 素有“金温江”之称

candidates.name: Yufu
candidates.meaning: "Fishing cormorant": third king of ancient Shu, with the Yufu tomb and the Yufu village walled-city site in Wenjiang; "Cancong and Yufu" is the opening line of Li Bai's Shu Dao Nan.
candidates.fit: Both the Yufu village city and the king's tomb lie in Wenjiang.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 445 hits with 四川.
candidates.source_note: 鱼凫王墓遗址位于現今温江区寿安镇水星村

regions.summary: Jinniu district, Chengdu's north-west inner ring (92%).

candidates.name: Jinniu
candidates.meaning: "Golden ox": from the legend that Qin carved stone oxen said to excrete gold to lure Shu's king into building a road; the Jinniu road leads to Shu.
candidates.fit: Holds 76% of the district and is 92% of the region.
candidates.recognisability: Current district; Jinniu Road is a famous ancient Shu route.
candidates.source_note: 1960年，郊区更名为金牛区，因境内“金牛坝”得名

regions.summary: Chenghua district (77%), the north-east of the inner city, with a bit of Jinniu and Longquanyi.

candidates.name: Chenghua
candidates.meaning: Made in 1991 from the first characters of Chengdu county and Huayang county, which it once belonged to.
candidates.fit: Holds 77% of the district and is 77% of the region.
candidates.recognisability: Current district; Zhaojue Temple and the Chengdu East station are here.
candidates.source_note: 成华区在历史上曾分属原成都县、华阳县，故以成都、华阳两地名的第一个字命名

regions.notes: A made-up 1991 name, but it is the district name. No older name sits here.

regions.summary: Qingyang district (87%), the west of the old city, including the Jinsha site.

candidates.name: Qingyang
candidates.meaning: "Green goat": named for the Qingyang Gong Daoist temple in the district.
candidates.fit: Holds 60% of the district and is 87% of the region; the 25% of Qingyang's people in region 14 are inside the old city.
candidates.recognisability: Current district; Qingyang Gong is one of Chengdu's best-known temples.
candidates.source_note: 因辖区内著名道观青羊宫而得名

candidates.name: Jinsha
candidates.meaning: "Gold sand": the Jinsha site (c. 1250-650 BC), where the Sun Bird gold ornament was found in 2001; the street is named Jinsha.
candidates.fit: The site lies in Jinsha street (8% of the region) in the north-west corner of the old city.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 480 hits with 四川, top ones about this place; but 金沙 is also the Jinsha River of Yunnan and Sichuan.
candidates.source_note: 金沙遗址位于成都市青羊区苏坡乡金沙村（现为成都市青羊区金沙街道）

regions.notes: Jinsha clashes with the Jinsha River (Yibin, Panzhihua, Lijiang); another agent may want it for the river.

regions.summary: The old city of Chengdu inside the first ring: Jinjiang, Qingyang and Chenghua parts.

candidates.name: Chengdu
candidates.meaning: City of the Shu kings since the 4th century BC; also commandery Shu, province Yizhou and prefecture Chengdu fu seated here.
candidates.fit: The old city; holds the CHGIS seat of Chengdu county, Yizhou, Shu commandery, Chengdufu.
candidates.recognisability: City of 14.6M by simplemaps.
candidates.source_note: 成都（县, 314 BC-1911）今四川成都市旧城区; 春秋末期（约公元前4世纪），古蜀国第五世开明王把都城迁至成都

regions.notes: Per the rules, only this region takes Chengdu.

regions.summary: Wuhou district's northern half (96% of the region), around Wuhou Temple, the south station and Yulin.

candidates.name: Wuhou
candidates.meaning: "Marquis of Wu": Zhuge Liang's title; the district is named after the Wuhou Temple, one of few counties named after a person.
candidates.fit: Holds 39% of the district and is 96% of the region; the temple sits in Jiangxijie sub-district (8.5% of region).
candidates.recognisability: Wuhou Temple is a major Three Kingdoms site.
candidates.source_note: 武侯区因其辖区内的武侯祠（诸葛亮）而得名，区人民政府驻浆洗街街道武侯祠大街264号

regions.notes: Region 17 is also 93% Wuhou district; Wuhou here and Tianfu there avoids a repeat.

regions.summary: Longquanyi district (98%), the east suburb at the foot of Longquan mountain.

candidates.name: Longquanyi
candidates.meaning: "Dragon spring post station": a post station set up at Longquan town in 1513; the area was earlier Lingchi and Lingquan counties.
candidates.fit: Holds 72% of the district and is 98% of the region.
candidates.recognisability: Current district; peach-blossom festival, car plants.
candidates.source_note: 正德八年（1513年）置龙泉镇巡检司，设驿站龙泉驿

candidates.name: Longquanshan
candidates.meaning: "Dragon spring mountain": the narrow range of 600 to 1000 m that divides the Chengdu plain from the hills to the east.
candidates.fit: The range runs through this district's east, but also Jintang and Jianyang, so a landscape name only.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article (Chengdu), only 47 hits with 四川; Longquan in Zhejiang is better known.
candidates.source_note: 东部为龙泉山脉和盆中丘陵，龙泉山脉海拔600至1000米，为成都平原和盆中丘陵的分界线

regions.summary: Wuhou's southern half (93%): Guixi, Cujin, Huaxing, the Hi-tech zone along Tianfu Avenue.

candidates.name: Tianfu
candidates.meaning: "Heavenly storehouse": the traditional name of the fertile Sichuan basin (Tianfu zhi guo); Tianfu Square and Avenue are the centre of the zone.
candidates.fit: Tianfu Avenue and the Hi-tech zone run through this region.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article (天府之国), 6479 hits with 四川.
candidates.source_note: 天府新区将成为云贵川渝地区的第3个国家级新区

regions.notes: Tianfu is a nickname for all of Sichuan; another Sichuan agent may want it for a basin region. The region's own unit is Wuhou, which region 15 takes.

regions.summary: Chongzhou (54%) and Dayi (42%), the plain west of Wenjiang.

candidates.name: Chongzhou
candidates.meaning: Named from Chongqing prefecture, Song, itself the old Shuzhou (Tang, 686); its Han county was Jiangyuan.
candidates.fit: Holds 73% of Chongzhou and is 54% of the region; Shuzhou seated at Huaiyuan town covered Jinyuan, Tanglong, Qingcheng and Xinjin.
candidates.recognisability: Current county-level city; "Shu within Shu".
candidates.source_note: 唐朝垂拱二年（686年）置蜀州……南宋绍兴十四年（1146年）升为崇庆府

candidates.name: Dayi
candidates.meaning: "Large town": Tang county of 631; the Xiling snow mountain, Liu Wencai's manor and Heming mountain, where Daoism began, are in the county.
candidates.fit: Holds 81% of Dayi's people and is 42% of the region.
candidates.recognisability: Current county; Xiling Snow Mountain and Liu manor are well known.
candidates.source_note: 大邑县（县, 631-1911）; 著名旅游胜地西岭雪山地处大邑县境内

regions.notes: Two near-equal counties. I put Chongzhou first for its seat and the bigger share.

regions.summary: South-east inner ring: Jinjiang (58%) and part of Longquanyi (25%), the Sansheng flower villages.

candidates.name: Liulichang
candidates.meaning: "Glazed-tile yard": old place name from the Tang-Song Liulichang kiln site; the Liuli township (琉璃乡) was split in 2004 into Liujiang and Chenglong Road sub-districts.
candidates.fit: Liujiang (19%) and Chenglong Road (25%) are its successors, 44% of the region's people; the kiln and the old name lie at the region's western edge.
candidates.recognisability: 17 hits with 四川, no own article for the name, but the kiln has one; known locally from a metro station.
candidates.source_note: 其所在地的地名“琉璃场”……均因琉璃厂窑而得名; 2004年撤销琉璃乡、三圣乡，设立柳江街道、成龙路街道、三圣街道 (锦江区)

candidates.name: Sansheng
candidates.meaning: Township (三圣乡) until 2004, now Sansheng sub-district; I found no source for the origin of the name.
candidates.fit: Sansheng is 9% of the region's people; it is the flower-village countryside on the south-east edge of the old Jinjiang.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, but only 24 hits with 四川.
candidates.source_note: 三圣街道，原为三圣乡，位于成都市主城区东南部

candidates.name: Shizishan
candidates.meaning: "Lion hill": an old local hill name, now a sub-district with Sichuan Normal University.
candidates.fit: Lion Hill sub-district is only 5% of the region.
candidates.recognisability: 272 hits with 四川 but most are other places called Shizishan (Ziyang, Liangshan).
candidates.source_note: 狮子山街道，是成都市锦江区下辖的一个乡镇级行政单位; 因老地名“狮子山”而得名

candidates.name: Jinjiang
candidates.meaning: "Brocade river": the river through Chengdu where Shu brocade was washed; the district is named for it.
candidates.fit: Holds 53% of the district and is 58% of the region by people.
candidates.recognisability: Current district.
candidates.source_note: 原名东城区，因流经其区域的锦江得名

regions.notes: Anita rejected Jinjiang: the actual Jinjiang is in the city centre, far from this region. No historic county seat and no real river run through this area; names are all weak. Dongfeng Canal (东风渠, 18 hits) and Damian (大面, 2 hits) were checked and dropped.

regions.summary: Shuangliu (97%), the south-west suburb with the old airport.

candidates.name: Shuangliu
candidates.meaning: "Two streams": renamed in 601 for lying between the Pi and Liu rivers (or from a line of the Shu Capital Rhapsody).
candidates.fit: Holds 46% of Shuangliu and is 97% of the region; the county seat and airport are here.
candidates.recognisability: Current district; name of the Chengdu airport.
candidates.source_note: 隋仁寿元年（601年）……更名为双流县，因双流地处郫江、流江二江之间而得名

candidates.name: Guangdu
candidates.meaning: Han county, name of the area before Shuangliu; the Shan Hai Jing's "Duguang plain" where Hou Ji is buried.
candidates.fit: Seat of Guangdu county for 820 yrs, at today's Shuangliu seat.
candidates.recognisability: 36 hits with 四川, no own article; only a metro station.
candidates.source_note: 双流原名广都，始见于《山海经·海内经》

regions.summary: Jintang (60%), part of Jianyang, Lezhi and Qingbaijiang: hills east of Chengdu where the Tuo leaves the plain.

candidates.name: Jintang
candidates.meaning: "Golden hall": named for the Jintang mountain in the county, Tang 671.
candidates.fit: Holds 88% of Jintang and is 60% of the region.
candidates.recognisability: Current county; Jintang Gorge.
candidates.source_note: 咸亨二年（671年）……建置金堂县，以界有金堂山得名

candidates.name: Tuojiang
candidates.meaning: "Tuo river": the Yangtze tributary whose three sources include the Mianyuan; it runs through Deyang's plain and on through Jintang.
candidates.fit: Runs through Jintang and Jianyang from north-west to south-east, but its course is long and goes on into other regions.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 283 hits with 四川.
candidates.source_note: 沱江，古称江沱，又名外江、中江，是中华人民共和国四川省中部的一条河流

regions.notes: Jianyang (20%) and Lezhi are not recommended: a small slice of each. Tuojiang may be wanted by Zigong or Luzhou agents downstream.

regions.summary: Huayang and Xinxing: the southern suburb along Tianfu Avenue, in Shuangliu (94%).

candidates.name: Huayang
candidates.meaning: An old literary name for Shu ("Tianfu, originally called Huayang"), also the title of the Huayang guozhi; the county seated in Chengdu's old city 758-1911.
candidates.fit: Huayang street holds 56% of the region; the county later covered the area south-east of the city.
candidates.recognisability: zh-wiki article on the county, 991 hits with 四川; the name is common elsewhere in China.
candidates.source_note: 华阳，据说是因古人论蜀之繁富有“地称天府，原号华阳”之说

regions.notes: Region 20 also takes a Shuangliu unit, so this avoids repeating that name; the CHGIS Huayang seat is the old city (region 14), so Huayang here rests on the town and the county's later territory.

regions.summary: Qionglai (63%) and Pujiang (23%) in the south-west, with parts of Dayi and Mingshan.

candidates.name: Qionglai
candidates.meaning: Named for the Qionglai mountains; the city was Linqiong, with the prefecture Qiongzhou seated here from 539.
candidates.fit: Holds 99% of Qionglai and is 63% of the region; Qiongzhou covered Pujiang too.
candidates.recognisability: Current county-level city, one of the four ancient cities of Ba-Shu.
candidates.source_note: 邛崃有2300多年的筑城史，是巴蜀四大古城之一

candidates.name: Linqiong
candidates.meaning: Han county seated at Qionglai (314 BC-1284), 1340 yrs.
candidates.fit: Seat is Linqiong town, the biggest part of the region.
candidates.recognisability: 58 hits with 四川, commandery article exists; a literary name (Zhuo Wenjun).
candidates.source_note: 临邛郡……治所在临邛县（今四川省邛崃市）

regions.notes: Pujiang county is 23% of the region and not recommended; its name is too small for the whole region.

regions.summary: Xinjin (38%), southern Shuangliu (41%), a bit of Pengshan and Renshou, on the Min River south of Chengdu.

candidates.name: Xinjin
candidates.meaning: "New ferry": the name comes from a new ford opened in 216 across the Min at Pengshan by the Qianwei governor Li Yan.
candidates.fit: Holds 98% of Xinjin and is 38% of the region; seat is in the region.
candidates.recognisability: Current district; Baodun site and the Min River crossing.
candidates.source_note: 东汉建安二十一年（公元216年）……新渡口，新津这一地名由此诞生

candidates.name: Baodun
candidates.meaning: The Baodun culture, a Neolithic city site in Xinjin, the largest of Chengdu plain's prehistoric walled cities.
candidates.fit: Site is in Xinjin (Longma township).
candidates.recognisability: Article on the culture, 620 hits with 四川; known mainly to archaeology readers.
candidates.source_note: 宝墩遗址为目前发现的最大的一个，约250万平方米

regions.notes: 41% of the people are in suburban Shuangliu (Shiyuan, Shigao), which region 20 already uses, so a Xinjin name suits the region best.
